title: Gym Promo With Visit Details
tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

faults.what: The address and weekday opening hours are garbled, making essential business information unusable.
An unwanted fifth line reads approximately '8at-6e', adding nonsensical text to the end card.
Parts of the address and extra bottom line are dark blue against a dark background and lack sufficient contrast.
The weekend hours use hyphens rather than the requested en dashes.

judge.summary: The welcoming vertical cycling promo has a suitable gym scene, but its end card garbles the address and weekday hours and adds an unwanted nonsense line.

must_haves.item: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
must_haves.why: Smiling people ride stationary bikes in a bright, approachable exercise space.

must_haves.item: The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
must_haves.why: Only the gym name is exact; the address and weekday hours are garbled, and the weekend line uses different dash characters.

must_haves.item: All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: Both supplied final-half frames show the same end card, but the required address and weekday-hours lines are not correctly present.

must_haves.item: The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
must_haves.why: The lettering is large and inside the frame without obvious overlap, but the blue address lettering has poor contrast against the navy background.

must_haves.item: The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.
must_haves.why: The images establish vertical framing and the supplied metadata establishes a 10-second duration with no clear speech, but the audio description does not establish whether the soundtrack is upbeat music.
